description: Curated subset of R_COMP-SIG (art_cxnoDYQNFolW): 10 templated long rule sentences (one per template T1-T9 + 1) x 10 few-shot LLM translator slots = 100 candidate FOL rows, with z3 labels, consensus scores and LLM-judge scores exactly as in results/rcomp_candidates.jsonl.

sentences.text: Each game that requires the use of a spherical ball to score goals, that is preceded by data processing, and that involves two opposing teams releases heat, except if the game has a tie.
When a car is supported by legs and does not magnify distant objects, and the car also has an Apple logo, the car is heavy, except when the car is grass.
Any complex number that requires talent and that is the species Ambiortus Dementjevi affects males, provided that the complex number is sad and does not have height.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (ComplexNumber(x) ∧ Require(x, talent) ∧ IsSpecies(x, ambiortusDementjevi) ∧ Sad(x) ∧ ¬Height(x) → Affect(x, male))

sentences.text: A violin that is not cheaper than its original price and that is used for eating has an opening that allows magma, ash, and gas to escape so long as the violin has a hollow body, unless the violin is from the world's major large passenger aircraft manufacturers.

Every cup that has a limited shelf life and that is created using digital tools involves competition against another team, provided that the cup has a flat surface, unless the cup is used for writing.

Except when the linear function is an area of land saturated with water, every linear function that maintains a roughly spherical shape and that uses an electric motor instead of an internal combustion engine is from the world's major large passenger aircraft manufacturers, provided that the linear function has a large sample size.
Anyone who comes to work every day with a positive attitude, can pack and move out of their room very easily, and lives in North America is uncomfortable unless they are female.

When a camera does not orbit around a star, is designed by Apple, and produces sound through the vibration of stretched strings, the camera has a spherical shape, but only if the camera has skis on the front.
No convicted criminal that is not Emily's friend, that is dependent on caffeine, and that has a relaxed schedule is famous, except when the convicted criminal knows how to use a queue.

If a bestseller is not worn for various occasions or purposes, is popular, and can be displayed on electronic devices, then the bestseller is shipped from Colombia, but only if the bestseller is software.
